documents.text:
California Government Code.

§ 53166.
(a) Each local agency that uses cellular communications interception technology shall develop a usage and privacy policy governing that use; the usage and privacy policy shall be posted conspicuously on that Internet Web site.
(b) A local agency shall not acquire cellular communications interception technology unless the acquisition is approved by its legislative body by resolution or ordinance.
